notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Update:
New store and 4 new gardenbeds.
These new items can be unlocked though the questline.

Fixes:
Updated game icon (was appearing as a black square)
Removed mouse positioning triggered by the tutorial boxes.

Other:
Downsized the minimap.

notes.title: One week until release!
notes.content:
Hi!

We are one week from release and we've been making huge steps in developing Rooftop Garden Simulator.
Next Monday, August first, we are going live :)

A small sum up of what we've been working on:
New level
New questline
New items
Improved building and growing system
Small bug fixes.

Because our game has changed so much, we are discontinuing the demo next week.

Stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481701/2d0f24869190f0369cb8cdcd47d8f2bf42a7c80b.png[/img]
